members.name: label
doc: Say what to type in words, WITHOUT the value itself: "Type his ticket number to confirm".

members.name: className
doc: The look of the box; each tool passes its own family of colours.

members.name: mark
doc: Optional data attribute for the tests and the scripts of the tool: { name: "data-emp-field", value: "confirm" }.

symbols.name: TypedConfirm
symbols.sig: export function TypedConfirm({ id, label, value, onChange, className, inputMode = "numeric", maxLength = 12, mark }: TypedConfirmProps)

params.name: { id, label, value, onChange, className, inputMode = "numeric", maxLength = 12, mark }

behaviours: the label says what to type, in words, and the box starts empty
it carries the mark of the tool for its tests and scripts, and the box is linked to its label
it is a numeric text box of the length asked, with no autocomplete and no spell check
it says plainly that pasting is switched off (and the hint is linked to the box for screen readers)
what is typed is shown as typed (it is the person's own typing), and nothing else is written in the box
a tool without a mark gets none (no stray attribute)
pasting, dropping and dragging over the box are all refused (the events are cancelled)
the component never receives the value to type, so it cannot print it: its props have no 'expected', 'answer' or 'target' field
the value is cleared only by its owner (the component keeps no state of its own)
